event: Details of the fourth DHE SDA revision emerged: more destination countries are relaxed, one more bank is added as a placement bank, and the conversion cap would rise from 50% to up to 100%. (update of E0595)
key_numbers: Placement banks total 16 (5 BUMN + 11 non-BUMN), PT Bank OCBC NISP added · relaxation extended to South Korea, Japan and EU (previously US, Canada, China incl. Hong Kong, Australia; rakortas 3 Nov 2026) · conversion cap 50% -> up to 100% · rule targeted to finish end-November · conversion to rupiah down 37.4% per LNSW head Oza Olavia · detik says 'five countries' but lists fewer (unverified)

event: The FBI, CISA and the US health, transport and agriculture departments issued a joint warning to disconnect internet-connected commercial refrigeration controllers after hackers raised temperatures in supermarket freezers in the US and Europe.
key_numbers: At least 3 hacks in recent months · second wave hit over 100 European stores · Irish chain SuperValu: 13 of 223 stores affected (2 Nov) · France attack in October reportedly cost tens of millions of euros · Pentagon probing an August outage at a US base grocery store

event: The Dutch cabinet announced it will cut about 25,000 civil-service jobs (16%) over 10 years and have AI take over routine tasks, in what CNBC Indonesia calls the first large plan to cut permanent staff because of technology.
key_numbers: 16% of civil servants, about 25,000 posts, over 10 years · savings €900 million in 2027 rising to €3.5 billion (≈Rp71 trillion) by 2035 · civil servants grew from 140,000 (2021) to 170,000 (2026) per Telegraaf · police and defence excluded · AI plan details due Q1 2027
